kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.

notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf map with no finish (see maps/zones/README.md). 125 placed weapons, team spawns, jail1 and a 'bye_bye_room'; teleports return players to the top, the middle or their spawn. gb-maps-1 batch of 2026-10-09. Not published.
